trap.label: e-mail de reclamação
trap.wrong: I am writing for to draw your attention.
trap.right: I am writing to draw your attention to broken street lights.
trap.why: Em português “chamar sua atenção para” leva para. Em inglês: draw your attention to + substantivo; I am writing to + base.

mcq.q: I am writing to draw your attention ___ the lights.

opts: Broken street lights on Marsh Lane — request for repair

fix.wrong: I look forward for your reply.
fix.right: I look forward to your reply.

fix.wrong: I am writing for draw your attention.
fix.right: I am writing to draw your attention.

rewrite.prompt: Use I am writing to: “I tell you about broken lights.”
rewrite.answer: I am writing to draw your attention to broken lights.

rewrite.prompt: Use look forward to: “I wait for your reply.”
rewrite.answer: I look forward to your reply.
